description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Adult woman with composed natural slender figure, oval mature face, pale blue-gray eyes and a calm knowing smile. Dark TEAL hair center-parted with LONG STRAIGHT cheek locks down to shoulders, the rest gathered in a low rounded bun behind head. Very dark navy tailored trouser suit, white shirt and dark navy tie. Bare face, no mask or glasses. Do not replace visible pale eyes with black irises from lore. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 200-206px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo.

style_image.usage_description: Use ONLY native standing scale, pixel rendering and strict front pose. Keep target original hair, eye color, face, body, clothing and colors. Do not copy identity or sunglasses.
